subject.title: fix(gateway): fail fast on missing local probe auth

question: Should unresolved required local gateway credentials suppress the shipped status probe by default?
rationale: The patch is coherent and well proven, but this changes an auth-sensitive released fallback and operator recovery behavior; automated review cannot safely choose that permanent policy.

options.title: Preserve Probe Default
options.body: Keep the existing probe attempt and attach the actionable unresolved-credential diagnosis to its output.

options.title: Approve Fail Closed
options.body: Adopt immediate failure as the new default with explicit upgrade and recovery acceptance from gateway-auth owners.

recommendation.title: Preserve Probe Default
recommendation.body: Keep the existing probe attempt and attach the actionable unresolved-credential diagnosis to its output.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the major shared gateway auth and probe refactor and has the strongest individual history signal on this decision surface.
